title: Missing the Signal: Menopause, Metabolic Health & GLP-1s in Women’s Care
summary: Akute Health’s intuitive EHR powers independent practices from DPC and concierge to large digital clinics like WeightWatchers. Streamline charting, scheduling, messaging, and eRx in one customizable platform that helps you put patients first.
body_markdown:
#### Dr. Lily Johnston and Dr. Komal Patil-Sisodia on catching metabolic risk earlier and treating it smarter, both in the exam room and between visits.


For concierge, primary care, longevity and wellness practices: a peer-to-peer session on catching metabolic risk earlier and the role of GLP-1s in women's health.


Many of your patients are doing everything right and still watching their weight, insulin sensitivity, and cardiovascular risk change as they move through perimenopause and menopause, often quietly between visits. Two physician-founders will share what they're seeing in practice and what's working.


Join endocrinologist, Dr. Komal Patil-Sisodia, and vascular surgeon, Dr. Lily Johnston, for a clinical conversation on spotting metabolic risk earlier, the role of GLP-1s, and keeping patients on track between appointments.


#### Live Webinar
Wednesday, November 11th @ 12-12:45 P.M. PST / 3-3:45 P.M. EST


[Register Here](https://2tpkv.share-na2.hsforms.com/2H3npDYTTSrOXYbbHdv254w)


##### **What you'll learn:**


1.


Why screening should start sooner: when to begin metabolic screening, why age 35 is a meaningful starting point, and what to check when a patient comes in with perimenopause symptoms.


2.


How falling hormones unmask metabolic disease: the link between declining estrogen, insulin resistance and the rise in cardiometabolic risk for women.


3.


Where GLP-1s fit: when and how to use them, including lower-dose approaches, and why they work best on top of a lifestyle foundation, not as a replacement for one.


4.


Keeping patients on track between visits: where patients often fall off track, and how ongoing communication and timely support improve outcomes.


5.


Bringing it into practice: practical takeaways you can apply with your own patients.


##### **Meet the speakers:**


###### **Dr. Lily Johnston, MD, MPH, FSVS**


Dr. Lily Johnston, MD, MPH, FSVS, is a vascular surgeon, board-certified obesity medicine physician and founder of CorSight Health in San Diego. Her book,[Disconnected: A Surgeon’s Search for Healing in a Broken System](https://amplifypublishinggroup.com/product/nonfiction/industries/healthcare-and-medical/disconnected/) , comes out November 10, 2026.


###### **Dr. Komal Patil-Sisodia, MD, DABOM, MSCP**


Dr. Komal Patil-Sisodia, MD, DABOM, MSCP, is an endocrinologist, obesity medicine specialist and Menopause Society Certified Practitioner. She is the founder of Eastside Menopause & Metabolism and hosts the[Clearly Hormonal](https://www.eastsidemm.com/podcast) podcast.
